theme: controlling only what you can control
lines: You are *exhausting* yourself by trying to fix everything.
Most of the world will never ask for your *consent*.
You cannot quiet the *storm* outside your front door.
But you can always choose how you hold your *ground*.
Master your reaction, and the world loses its *power* over you.
spoken: You are exhausting yourself by trying to fix everything. Most of the world will never ask for your consent. You cannot quiet the storm outside your front door. But you can always choose how you hold your ground. Master your reaction, and the world loses its power over you.

lines: The suffering you feel is not trying to *destroy* you.
It is simply asking you to pay *attention*.
Comfort conceals the truth, but struggle *reveals* it.
Do not curse the *sting* that wakes your mind.
Every scar is a *lesson* you finally understood.
